main_text.p: vis hisce apophoretis accumulari. Scripserat supra, Basilius a Photio tanquam homicida excommunicatus sacris fuit prohibitus. Sequitur Zonaram, qui ad hæc tempora inaudi-tam eiectionis Photianæ causam ex Georgij Hamartoli Historia, vt puto, extraxit, vt videre potes, si huiusce historiam præ manibus habes, sin minus, beabo te, si verba exscripsero. Sunt vero. Τῆ δὲ Βασιλίως ἐν τῇ Ἐκκλησίᾳ ἀπαλλαγεὶς, ἡ τῆς ἀρχαίας θυσίας μετάλαβὼν βασιλεύοντος, ὁ Παλαιολόγος Φωτίος τῆς Θεᾶς αὐτὸν ἀπορρήξεως μεγάλης ἀνεφόβουν ἀνάξιον. ἐπ' οἷς Θυμωθεὶς ὁ Βασιλεὺς ἐκ Ῥώμης ἐπισκόπους ἐλθεῖν παρεκάλεσε, Τόμον ἐπιφέροντας τὸ Πάπα, καὶ τὸ Πατριαρχικὸν θρόνον ἐξωθῆσαι, Ἰγνάτιον δὲ τὸν ἐξωθηθέντα πατριάρχην ἀπεδείξατο τὸ δεύτερον. Cum vero in Ecclesiam ingressus esset Imperator, & immaculati Sacrificij particeps fieri vellet, Patriarcha Photius a diuina Communione exturbauit, homicidam vocitans & prædonem, et immaculatorum Mysteriorum indignum. Quibus exasperatus Imperator, Romā Episcopos Byzantium aduocauit Tomum Pontificis ferentes, & sic eum e Patriarchali sede expulit: Sanctum vero Ignatium Patriarcham secundo promouit. page.notes: The Greek passage is badly degraded in the scan. Its word forms are my best reading and are not verified letter by letter; the Greek should be checked against another copy before use. The Latin is clear except where noted. The left margin has only ink spots, which I left out. The long s is rendered as plain s throughout, and the final line ends on a split word ("se-"), which I kept as printed.
